segments.name: Procedural Solutions for Compromised Bone
segments.description: Develops and markets minimally invasive titanium implants and instruments for sacroiliac joint dysfunction, thoracolumbar fixation, and pelvic trauma.
segments.evidence: We are a leader in developing innovative procedural solutions for compromised bone, grounded in expertise in biomechanical design and anatomy-specific innovation.

revenueModel.text: Sells titanium implants and instruments to hospitals and surgical centers primarily through direct sales force and third-party agents.
revenueModel.evidence: We market our products primarily with a direct sales force as well as a number of third-party sales agents in the United States, and with a combination of a direct sales force, sales agents and resellers in other countries.
